📊 Candlestick Strength Guide

This visual breaks down how to read the strength of bullish and bearish candles, a key skill for understanding market momentum.

On the bullish side, stronger candles have full bodies with minimal wicks, showing decisive buying pressure. As the wicks get longer and the bodies get smaller, the strength weakens  buyers are losing control. 📈

On the bearish side, the same principle applies. Strong bearish candles have solid bodies with little rejection. As the candle weakens, wicks grow and the body shrinks, showing hesitation from sellers. 📉

Recognizing these subtle differences helps traders avoid weak signals and focus on candles that show real intent and power in the market. 📱 @nursejannah

Jadikan pemeriksaan rumah sebagai rutin mingguan keluarga. Luangkan sekurang-kurangnya 10 minit setiap minggu untuk:

✅ Cari tempat yang menakung air
✅ Buang bekas yang tidak digunakan
✅ Buang air bertakung
✅ Sental permukaan bekas
✅ Gunakan bahan pembunuh jentik-jentik jika perlu
✅ Tutup rapat bekas simpanan air

Tip mudah: Tetapkan satu hari setiap minggu, contohnya pada hujung minggu, supaya pemeriksaan rumah lebih mudah diingati dan diamalkan secara konsisten.

Jangan tunggu sehingga berlaku kes denggi di kawasan anda.

Hanya 10 minit tindakan anda setiap minggu boleh membantu melindungi seisi keluarga daripada risiko denggi.
